name: Chang'e-5 FTD RV
about: Chang'e-5 FTD RV (2014-065, CASC), launched 2014 Oct 23. Its phases from GCAT: Luna, Earth, 111E 42N. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.
